correctness.rationale: The assumptions lambda_n->lambda in (0,infinity), maximal individual edge probability eps_n->0 and weak convergence nu_n on compact [0,1] are adequate. For fixed m tags, hyperedges intersecting tags in exact subsets S give independent Poisson-binomial counts with mean sum_r binom(n-m,r-|S|)p_nr. The uniform O_m(1/n) hypergeometric ratio yields mu_S=int x^(|S|-1)(1-x)^(m-|S|) nu(dx). Le Cam error <=eps_n*m*lambda_n goes to zero and yields the correlated subset-shock limit. Construct PPP of intensity nu(dx)/x on (0,1] with independent Bernoulli marks and independent singleton dust of intensity nu({0}); finite intensity of sum_x x ensures almost-sure product. Tagged mixed moments identify the random conditional-iid empirical degree masses; a uniform expected-degree tail bound ensures l1 tightness. The Poisson exponential formula gives E P(0)=exp(-lambda), Var P(0)=exp(-2lambda)(exp(int x nu(dx))-1), and log E P(0)^k= sum_{j=1}^k (-1)^j binom(k,j) M_{j-1}; Hausdorff determinacy recovers nu. Rounded/clipped rank construction makes all finite measures attainable even with atoms at 0 or 1.
